elaine: ran a targeted nsys + perfetto shot on the 4xA100 pipeline this morning. seeing periodic 1.5-3ms gaps between model kernels where NCCL allreduce sits idle. KV cache markers show repeated invalidation events right before the gaps.
matt: did you capture nvtx ranges? maybe selector switching?
elaine: yes, nvtx and roofline markers. attaching quick command I used:
elaine: ```bash
nsys profile -t cuda,nvtx,cudnn,nccl -o /tmp/shot1 --capture-range=nvtx --capture-range-end=stop
# and perfetto trace: python -m perfetto --out /tmp/trace.pb --record
```
devon: can you paste the nccl timeline slice? i'm thinking there's partial serialization—allreduce not overlapping with compute
elaine: pasted a short excerpt (timestamps relative):
elaine: ```
[100.0] kernel A (model forward)
[101.2] NCCL Allreduce start
[101.3] kernel B (kv lookup)
[102.5] NCCL Allreduce end
[104.0] kernel C (attention)
```
ryan: kv lookup in middle of allreduce? that suggests kv cache handshake is preempting the comm stream
sasha: could be kernel selector switching quantized kernels then copying weights -> preemption
elaine: exactly — kernel selector log shows a fallback path triggered every ~8th microbatch due to tensor stride mismatch. that triggers a small memcpy + kernel relaunch.
matt: those fallbacks would break NCCL progress if they run on same stream and cause scheduling bubbles.
devon: try setting selector to sticky mode and re-run with --trace-nccl to confirm
elaine: did that: sticky reduced gaps to ~0.3ms but throughput still down 4%. nvprof shows extra small memcpy on stream1 right before fallback.
ryan: can you dump the kernel launch params? maybe batch packing heuristic causes odd seq_len distribution leading to path flip
elaine: pasted params sample:
elaine: ```json
{"batch_sizes": [1,2,1,4,1,2,1,4], "seq_lens": [64,64,128,64,64,128,64,64], "quant_mode": "mixed", "selector_hint": "auto"}
```
sasha: those repeated 128s would trigger different kernel. batching heuristic shouldn't mix seq_len patterns across the same worker epoch
matt: actionable: 1) enforce per-microbatch homogenous packing; 2) make selector sticky for a short window; 3) make KV invalidation async w/ dedicated stream.
elaine: I'm going to run a comparator: baseline, sticky-selector, and async-kv. will post nsys flame slices. infra-bot: kickoff perf job #18321
infra-bot: perf job 18321 queued on eng-runtime-ci, estimated run 22m
devon: when you have traces, let's load into perfetto and look at transports + serializing kernels lane view
elaine: will share trace link in this thread. preliminary: sticky-selector + async-kv eliminated the 1.5-3ms bubble and recovered the 4% throughput.
matt: nice. follow-up: open PR to default selector sticky for TP runs and add metric for nvtx allreduce idle time
elaine: agreed. I'll draft PR and include perf graphs.
ryan: thanks — also add a regression test that runs a short nccl trace on the CI perf node
sasha: :thumbsup:
